# jsQR 1.4.0

A QR code reader in JavaScript by Cosmo Wolfe (Apache License 2.0, `LICENSE` beside this file),
https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR, copied unchanged from the npm package `jsqr@1.4.0` (`dist/jsQR.js`).

The QR code toy loads it only when it checks that a code scans, in a browser without
`BarcodeDetector` support for QR codes. The tests use the same copy.
